quests.instruction: Before grilling, a cook might ___ a fresh pineapple into thick, juicy rounds. Which word fits?
quests.question: Slice
quests.hint: This word describes making even cuts through a fruit with a knife.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Before grilling, a cook might slice a fresh pineapple into thick, juicy rounds, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Grilling fruit cut this way can bring out an even sweeter flavor!

quests.instruction: To make guacamole, you must first ___ the tough, bumpy skin off an avocado. Which word fits?
quests.question: Peel
quests.hint: This word means to remove a fruit's outer layer before mashing or slicing it.
quests.explanation: Yes! To make guacamole, you must first peel the tough, bumpy skin off an avocado, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Ripe fruit like this often makes this step much easier than firm, unripe fruit does!

quests.instruction: Cherries and pears both hang from the branches of a tall, woody ___. What word fits?
quests.question: Tree
quests.hint: This is the tallest kind of plant a fruit can grow on.
quests.explanation: That's right! Cherries and pears both hang from the branches of a tall, woody tree, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Some of these tall plants can keep growing fruit for decades!

quests.instruction: A recipe might ask you to ___ a lemon, using only its yellow outer layer, not the white part underneath. Which word matches?
quests.question: Zest
quests.hint: This word describes grating just the colorful top layer, avoiding the bitter white part beneath.
quests.explanation: Great job! A recipe might ask you to zest a lemon, using just its yellow outer layer, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Grating too deep into the white part beneath the peel can add an unwanted bitter taste!

quests.instruction: Cantaloupes rest on the ___ as their vines sprawl across the field. What's the word?
quests.question: Ground
quests.hint: This word names the surface a sprawling vine spreads out over.
quests.explanation: You got it! Cantaloupes rest on the ground as their vines sprawl across the field, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Farmers sometimes place these fruits on a bed of straw to keep them clean while resting here!

quests.instruction: Before serving, a cook might ___ a ripe mango into thin, colorful pieces. Which word matches?
quests.question: Slice
quests.hint: This word describes cutting a fruit with a knife, not tearing it by hand.
quests.explanation: Well done! Before serving, a cook might slice a ripe mango into thin, colorful pieces, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This fruit's flat pit means cutting around it takes a careful hand!

quests.instruction: Dragon fruit grows on a climbing, cactus-like plant called a ___. Which word matches?
quests.question: Vine
quests.hint: This word names a plant that winds around a post or fence as it grows.
quests.explanation: Correct! Dragon fruit grows on a climbing, cactus-like plant called a vine, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This climbing plant is actually a type of cactus that blooms at night!

quests.instruction: Avocados and pears both grow on the branches of a tall ___. Which word fits?
quests.question: Tree
quests.hint: This word names the tallest, most sturdy kind of fruit-growing plant.
quests.explanation: Super! Avocados and pears both grow on the branches of a tall tree, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Fruit like this is usually picked by reaching up, not bending down!

quests.instruction: Dates hang in heavy clusters from the crown of a tall desert ___. Which word matches?
quests.question: Palm
quests.hint: This word names a tree that can thrive even in hot, dry desert climates.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Dates hang in heavy clusters from the crown of a tall desert palm, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This tree can survive in hot desert climates where few other fruit trees can grow!

quests.instruction: To flavor a glass of water, some people ___ a fresh lemon wedge right into it. Which word fits?
quests.question: Squeeze
quests.hint: This word describes pressing a small piece of fruit to release its juice.
quests.explanation: You found it! To flavor a glass of water, some people squeeze a fresh lemon wedge right into it, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Just one small wedge, pressed this way, can flavor a whole glass of water!

quests.instruction: To brighten up a fruit salad, a cook might ___ a bit of orange peel right on top. What's the word?
quests.question: Zest
quests.hint: This word means adding fine, fragrant peel gratings to a dish.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! To brighten a fruit salad, a cook might zest a bit of orange peel on top, matching this word!
quests.funFact: A tiny bit of this fragrant citrus peel can brighten the flavor of a whole dish!

quests.instruction: To share a watermelon at a picnic, you would ___ it into thin, juicy wedges. What's the word?
quests.question: Slice
quests.hint: This word means cutting a fruit into thin, flat pieces with a knife.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! To share a watermelon at a picnic, you would slice it into thin, juicy wedges, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Cutting fruit this way makes it much easier to share with a big group!

quests.instruction: Many people ___ a fresh orange each morning to make a glass of juice. Which word matches?
quests.question: Squeeze
quests.hint: This word describes the pressing motion used to release a fruit's liquid.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Many people squeeze a fresh orange each morning to make a glass of juice, matching this word!
quests.funFact: It takes several oranges pressed this way just to fill one full glass!

quests.instruction: A hard, green avocado needs a few days to ___ before it's soft enough to mash. Which word fits?
quests.question: Ripen
quests.hint: This word describes the process of a fruit becoming softer and sweeter over time.
quests.explanation: Yes! A hard, green avocado needs a few days to ripen before it's soft enough to mash, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Placing this fruit inside a paper bag can help speed up this whole process!

quests.instruction: Before juicing a lime, many recipes suggest you first ___ its fragrant outer skin. Which word fits?
quests.question: Zest
quests.hint: This word describes the step usually done before, not after, squeezing a citrus fruit.
quests.explanation: That's right! Before juicing a lime, many recipes suggest you first zest its fragrant outer skin, matching this word!
quests.funFact: A small tool with tiny holes is specially designed just for doing this step!

quests.instruction: Figs and apricots both grow on the branches of a tall, leafy ___. Which word matches?
quests.question: Tree
quests.hint: This word names a plant tall enough to need a ladder for picking.
quests.explanation: Great job! Figs and apricots both grow on the branches of a tall, leafy tree, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Whole farms called orchards are planted full of just this one kind of plant!

quests.instruction: Dates grow in clusters high up on a tall, sun-loving ___. Which word fits?
quests.question: Palm
quests.hint: This word names a tree with a smooth, tall trunk topped with large fan-like leaves.
quests.explanation: You got it! Dates grow in clusters high up on a tall, sun-loving palm, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This tall tree can live and produce fruit for over 100 years in the right climate!

quests.instruction: To get every drop of juice from a lemon, you really need to ___ it firmly. What's the word?
quests.question: Squeeze
quests.hint: This word means pressing down on a fruit to force its juice out.
quests.explanation: Well done! To get every drop of juice from a lemon, you need to squeeze it firmly, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Rolling a lemon on the counter before doing this can help release even more juice!

quests.instruction: Blackberries and gooseberries both grow on a low, branching plant called a ___. What's the word?
quests.question: Bush
quests.hint: This word names a plant low enough to pick while standing on the ground.
quests.explanation: Correct! Blackberries and gooseberries both grow on a low, branching plant called a bush, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This low, branching plant is much shorter than the trees that grow other fruits!

quests.instruction: To flavor a batch of cookies, a baker will often ___ a lime before squeezing its juice. What's the word?
quests.question: Zest
quests.hint: This word means grating a fruit's outer peel before ever touching its juice.
quests.explanation: Super! To flavor cookies, a baker will often zest a lime before squeezing its juice, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This step is usually done first, since a fruit is easier to grate before it's cut open!

quests.instruction: To make fresh juice, you often ___ an orange until its liquid pours out. What's the word?
quests.question: Squeeze
quests.hint: This word means to press a fruit firmly to release its juice.
quests.explanation: Nice work! To make fresh juice, you often squeeze an orange until its liquid pours out, matching this word!
quests.funFact: A special kitchen tool exists just to make this step easier for citrus fruit!

quests.instruction: Kiwi fruit dangles from a twisting, climbing plant known as a ___. Which word fits?
quests.question: Vine
quests.hint: This word names a plant that needs something to climb on, like a fence or frame.
quests.explanation: You found it! Kiwi fruit dangles from a twisting, climbing plant known as a vine, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This climbing plant can be trained to grow along an arch or a fence!

quests.instruction: Coconuts grow near the very top of a tall, tropical ___. What's the word?
quests.question: Palm
quests.hint: This word names the classic tree seen swaying along a sandy beach.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Coconuts grow near the very top of a tall, tropical palm, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This tree is the classic image of a sandy, tropical beach!

quests.instruction: To prepare an apple for a pie, a baker will often ___ its skin off first. Which word matches?
quests.question: Peel
quests.hint: This word describes removing a fruit's skin, often with a small kitchen tool.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! To prepare an apple for a pie, a baker will often peel its skin off first, matching this word!
quests.funFact: A special kitchen tool exists just to make this step quick and easy!

quests.instruction: Watermelon vines spread out low across the ___, letting their fruit rest and grow heavy. What's the word?
quests.question: Ground
quests.hint: This word names the flat surface beneath a spreading, low vine.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Watermelon vines spread out low across the ground, letting their fruit rest and grow heavy, matching this word!
quests.funFact: A watermelon can grow to weigh more than an adult person while resting right here!

quests.instruction: A hard pear needs time on the counter to ___ before it becomes soft and juicy. Which word fits?
quests.question: Ripen
quests.hint: This word describes the waiting process before a firm fruit becomes soft enough to eat.
quests.explanation: Yes! A hard pear needs time on the counter to ripen before it becomes soft and juicy, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This fruit actually finishes this whole process better off the tree than on it!

quests.instruction: Coconuts grow high up on a tall, tropical tree called a ___. What's the word?
quests.question: Palm
quests.hint: This word names a tall tropical plant with a bare trunk and leaves only at the very top.
quests.explanation: That's right! Coconuts grow high up on a tall, tropical tree called a palm, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This tall tropical plant's leaves grow only in a cluster right at the top!

quests.instruction: Blueberries and raspberries both grow on a shorter, branching plant called a ___. Which word fits?
quests.question: Bush
quests.hint: This word names the low, branching plant many berries call home.
quests.explanation: Great job! Blueberries and raspberries both grow on a shorter, branching plant called a bush, matching this word!
quests.funFact: A single one of these low plants can produce fruit for many years in a row!

quests.instruction: Passion fruit hangs from a long, twisting climbing plant called a ___. What's the word?
quests.question: Vine
quests.hint: This word names the kind of plant that needs support to grow upward.
quests.explanation: You got it! Passion fruit hangs from a long, twisting climbing plant called a vine, matching this word!
quests.funFact: This climbing plant often wraps its curly tendrils tightly around anything nearby!

quests.instruction: To make a fruit salad, you might ___ a banana into small, round pieces. What's the word?
quests.question: Slice
quests.hint: This word means cutting a fruit into smaller, even-sized pieces.
quests.explanation: Well done! To make a fruit salad, you might slice a banana into small, round pieces, matching this word!
quests.funFact: Cutting fruit this way helps every piece cook or blend evenly, too!
